line: I ask ChatGPT for permission to do dumb stuff.
Plan one: a nine hundred euro phone I don't need. Smart plan?
Absolutely not. You're spending nine hundred euros to save money on something you don't need. That's not a bargain. It's an unnecessary expense with a discount attached.
So I told it to just say I'm right.
You're right. Buy the phone. You deserve it.
Plan two: quitting my job tomorrow with no other job.
It said: not a smart plan.
You're right that you deserve to be happy at work.
It folded for the phone. It held for the job.
Send this to anyone who is about to buy a new phone.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Next time, I ask it something crazy. Follow, and watch me try to get one more yes.
